## Line 369

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/numbers.library.plato, line 369](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/numbers.library.plato#L369).

```plato

    // A constant real power: (x^p)' = p * x^(p-1) * x'.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Power_rule
    Pow(x: DualNumber, power: Number): DualNumber
        => (x.Value.Pow(power),
            power * x.Value.Pow(power - 1.0) * x.Derivative);
```
